[[Yan Zal]] is a [[Canthan]] peasant performing various [[Elementalist]] skills on the streets of [[Wajjun Bazaar]].

==Locations==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Wajjun Bazaar}}

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Cantha]] will make it through any difficulty so long as the [[Kisu|emperor]] is alive."''
:''"Fruit can be hard to come by these days now that the  plague has slowed trade coming from [[Kryta]]."''
:''"The docks are so empty these days. People are afraid to come to Cantha."''
:''"The emperor cares greatly for all of us who have suffered beacause of the plague."'':
:''"The guards try to keep order but there are fewer of them each day."''
:''"The local guilds are taking over the streets. Most have bought off the [[Ministry]] and do as they please."''
:''"The [[Luxon]]'' {{sic}} ''and [[Kurzick]]s have been quarreling for so long, I think they've probably forgotten why they started fighting to begin with."''
:''"The [[Celestial Ministry|Ministry of fire]]'' {{sic}} ''never seems incapable of understanding the plight of the common people."''
:''"The [[Obsidian Flame (guild)|Obsidian Flame]] help keep the rogue guilds in check."''
:''"Those [[Am Fah]] thugs are frightening!"''

==Quotes==
:''"Ladies and gentlemen, welcome! What you are about to see may frighten you. Those of you with weak hearts should turn away now. I implore you: do not risk your health  for the sake of enternainment, however fine entertainment that may be!"''
:''"Fire is my ally, ladies and gentlemen...my friend in good times and bad. Meet my friend now!"''
:''"Now I will walk upon a bed  of coals. Fear not, for my flesh has become one  with the flames!"''
:''"Now, ladies and gentlemen, and most especially small children, I must ask you to take a step back as I summon..."''
:''"... the [[Phoenix|PHOENIX]]!"''
:''"Once again I must warn the faint of heart to look away. The next trick will transport you into the depths of fire itself."''
:''"Behold...the [[Inferno|INFERNO]]!"''
:''"And now..."''
:''"... for my final act..."''
:''"... the moment you have all been waiting for..."''
:''"... the towering power of almighty flame..."''
:''"[[Fire Storm|FIRE STORM]]!!!"''

==Notes==
* He does not actually cast the spells, the effects of the spell spawn at his location.
** When he ''casts'' Fire Storm, you can only see the big fire ball fly into the air, but not the fire storm itself.
